column1: # script: second_reference_seaad_2026-10-19/seaad_class_shares.py (class_means logic of analyses/interneuron_ph_2026-10-01/scripts/specificity.py), run 2026-10-19 on the remote environment

# input: nserc_pilots_2026-10-14/seaad_sst_loss_check/data/SEAAD_MTG_RNAseq_final-nuclei.2026-06-22.h5ad, 32978570763 bytes, sha256 e06000cb8fc83ebad88a52a0a7c772747c38fa92c97debcfe4f59de7cea60c79 (layers/UMIs, raw UMI counts, 1178694 nuclei x 36601 genes; SEA-AD MTG RNAseq final-nuclei, release file dated 2026-06-22; Gabitto et al. 2024 Nat Neurosci doi 10.1038/s41593-024-01774-5; h5ad uns title: MTG: Seattle Alzheimer's Disease Atlas (SEA-AD); no version string recorded in the file beyond the file date)

# input: hgnc_complete_set.txt sha256 69bb5722d5a4 (copy of data/reference/hgnc_complete_set.txt); recurrence_genes.tsv (scenario 'published, brain', q_bh < 0.1) sha256 dda5eb621c15; interneuron_specificity_383_v2.tsv sha256 61eeb76840ec

# genes: the 383 genes of recurrence_genes.tsv (the 8 extra genes MT1X SERPINA3 CLDN11 IL33R HILPDA KCNA1 ATP1A3 IFITM1 are already among the 383); matched by Ensembl id via HGNC first, current symbol in the h5ad var index second; see found_by; IL33R is the current HGNC symbol (HGNC:5998; previous symbol IL1RL1); no alias mapping was needed for any gene

# class mapping (SEA-AD Subclass -> fine class): Astro=Astrocyte; EN=L2/3 IT,L4 IT,L5 IT,L5 ET,L5/6 NP,L6 IT,L6 IT Car3,L6 CT,L6b; IN_other=Sncg,Pax6; LAMP5=Lamp5,Lamp5 Lhx6; Micro=Immune; OPC=OPC; Oligo=Oligodendrocyte; PVALB=Pvalb,Chandelier; SST=Sst; VIP=Vip; Vascular=Endothelial,VLMC & Perivascular
# unmapped Subclass labels (nuclei left out): Sst Chodl (899 nuclei; not in the requested mapping; a sensitivity run that adds it to SST is in seaad_agreement_with_psychad.tsv)

# Immune = SEA-AD label for microglia/PVM and a few other immune cells; used as Micro. 'VLMC & Perivascular' (VLMC + pericyte/SMC) and Endothelial = Vascular. PsychAD left PVM and Adaptive out; SEA-AD has no separate PVM label

# method: per donor and class, summed raw UMIs over all 36601 genes -> CPM over all genes of that pseudobulk; donor-class pseudobulks with >= 20 nuclei; class mean CPM = mean over qualifying donors; spec_<class> = class mean CPM / sum of the 11 fine-class mean CPMs; spec_coarse_IN / EN over 7 coarse classes (IN = SST+PVALB+VIP+LAMP5+IN_other pooled per donor); no CPM >= 1 filter; n_classes_measured = fine classes with mean CPM > 0

# differences from the PsychAD table: different tissue (middle temporal gyrus, not DLPFC), nuclei sorted/loaded by the SEA-AD protocol (includes NeuN-enriched sorting, so neuronal classes are over-represented relative to tissue; class shares use class means so this does not enter the shares directly), different class labels (see mapping), donors with no dementia (not psychiatric controls), older donors
# donors: 42 (No dementia); Age at Death mean 89.8, median 90, range 72-102 (42 with age recorded); sex 24 female, 18 male
# qualifying donors per fine class: Astro 42, EN 42, IN_other 42, LAMP5 42, Micro 42, OPC 42, Oligo 42, PVALB 42, SST 42, VIP 42, Vascular 39

# nuclei in qualifying donor-class pseudobulks per fine class: Astro 32271, EN 377922, IN_other 14105, LAMP5 29528, Micro 18152, OPC 16661, Oligo 55058, PVALB 50833, SST 28120, VIP 51197, Vascular 2630
